_comment: Hand-authored save and offline-progress tuning (master plan Phase 10). Time away is simulated with the real behaviour loop at step_seconds, up to cap_hours; the cap is a placeholder until the client decides (plan §14). Absences shorter than min_seconds count for nothing. A clock that moved backwards grants nothing.
_comment_rate: Share of the live pace earned while away: 1.0 = the same as watching, 0.5 = half the workouts. The client may want less than 1.
